breadth_audit._purpose: Makes actor-attribution (BREADTH_PLAN) observable. publishers_excluded is set-difference vs breadth_config.publisher_slugs; contrast count best-effort. median_breadth_30d drives threshold re-tune.
breadth_audit.publishers_excluded: deterministic — publisher slugs (techcrunch/cnbc/venturebeat/ft/reuters/arstechnica/heise etc.) filtered from every topic org set before counting
breadth_audit.contrast_comentions_excluded: agent estimate — Microsoft-MAI-vs-GPT-5.5 and open-vs-closed roundups attributed only to subject topic; Snowflake Summit + NVIDIA Agent Toolkit adopters counted as actors (each deploying)
